tools.name: intent_propose_purchase_mandate
tools.title: Search products and propose mandate
tools.description: Searches the live product catalog for a physical-product query and explicit hard budget, creates a versioned purchase mandate with optional destination and reputation thresholds, and opens Intent's shared decision room. Returns normalized product details, eligibility evidence, source provenance, and canonical state readback. Checkout authority remains absent.

query.description: The physical product to find, including every hard requirement the user stated.

budget.description: The user's hard total price ceiling in the mandate currency.

country.description: Two-letter destination country code; default to US only when the user did not specify one.

minimumRating.description: Hard minimum star rating, or 0 when the user did not specify one.

minimumReviews.description: Hard minimum review count, or 0 when the user did not specify one.

tools.name: intent_compare_candidates
tools.title: Compare product candidates
tools.description: Evaluates every live product candidate against every deterministic rule in the current human-visible mandate. Returns normalized product details, an audit summary, and exact reasons each offer is eligible or blocked, then records the evaluation in the shared collaboration history.

tools.name: intent_read_purchase_mandate
tools.title: Read purchase mandate
tools.description: Reads the current human-edited purchase mandate, selected product details, staged proposal, collaboration history, safe-resume and live-revalidation status, and the reason-coded lifecycle of checkout authority—including why the dynamic capability is absent and which actor owns the next step. Read-only; capability reasons are page-asserted transparency, not identity attestation.

tools.name: intent_stage_candidate_for_approval
tools.title: Stage candidate for approval
tools.description: Stages one eligible live candidate under the exact current mandate version, opens its human approval screen, and waits for the decision in the same tool call. Returns the human decision and canonical state readback. Approval makes a separate one-use checkout capability available; payment remains with the person and merchant.

variantId.description: The exact variantId of an eligible candidate returned by the current comparison.

mandateVersion.description: The current mandate version returned by Intent; earlier versions are stale after a human edit.
